scope: One owner-account draft conversation across ten approved collections.

readability.narrowPane: Heavily wrapped/crowded. Created and Modified headers break within words; YYYY-MM-DD values can split even within the year. Titles and tags also wrap over many lines, requiring vertical scrolling.
readability.boundary: The requested four-column structure is retained. No polished narrow/mobile rendering or Teams-client validation is claimed.

workbook.presentationBoundary: Compactness was visually verified on the prior actual export with the identical template. This run rechecks actual payload bytes, rows and date/formula results; no repeated deep workbook UI audit.

delivery: Owner-only final ACL; email to verified own profile accepted with HTTP 200. Inbox receipt is not claimed.
notClaimed: Owner-only smoke is not non-owner negative ACL/revocation proof.
HTTP 200 email action is connector acceptance, not inbox receipt.
No Teams rendering, authentication or publication validation.
No live missing/fractional timestamp edge-case claim.
No PolicyStatus/ReviewDate/stored-tag filtering or classic child-web claim.
proofBoundary: Actual native SharePoint paging, not readiness-probe or management API pagination.
